title: A member sees real computer and task context
description:
As an organization member, I want real computer and task context beside a conversation, so that I can understand active work without unsupported controls.

Feature: Workspace context inspector

Scenario: Inspect an individual bot
Given the selected bot has task provenance and the organization has a computer
When the member opens the inspector
Then the inspector shows the real computer identity, state, policy, and host start generation
And it shows tasks created or updated by that bot

Scenario: Inspect a named channel
Given the selected item is a named multi-bot channel
When the member opens the inspector
Then tasks are labeled as organization tasks
And the interface does not imply tasks are linked to that channel

comments.author: ryan
comments.text: Implemented locally: collapsible inspector shows current computer identity, running/stopped state, policy, and host-start generation; direct selections filter tasks by bot provenance and named channels are explicitly labeled organization tasks. Unsupported controls and mock previews remain absent.

comments.author: ryan
comments.text: Delivered by PR #346, squash commit 3fb29a57457df450a2f27d120ca9f126c279e6f1, and deployed through green development Web, ThinTurn, and Auth workflows. The inspector uses real computer and task APIs and does not expose deferred controls.
